question: Does the frozen BK22 appearance gate find a single shared bounded operator for one real-raster FiveK Expert C control when photograph identity supplies colour-independent content cells, while rejecting an exact pooled-target cell permutation?

source.content_cell_identity: exact FiveK photograph/pair identity, observed independently of pixel colour

optimization.device_reason: pre-freeze 8192-point 10-step smoke measured 7.13s CPU versus 7.17s CUDA; CPU avoids GPU overhead and preserves BK22 capacity

policy.selection: hard select one whole operator by confirmation pooled mean normalized residual; never blend

branch_rules.valid_hard_and_confounded_identity: retain a real-raster digital-retouch positive control for the external content-cell gate
branch_rules.valid_identity_and_confounded_identity: formal K=1/identity outcome: no shared Expert C appearance candidate passes every confirmation content cell
branch_rules.confounded_hard: close the gate as unsafe on real rasters
branch_rules.lineage_or_structure_failure: reject the experiment without visual review or rescue

allowed_actions: fit the unchanged BK22 two-objective O0 capacity on pooled development marginals only
destroy target row order before fitting and never use paired pixel correspondence
use exact photograph identity only for confirmation cell scoring
hard-select one explicit operator or return identity
forbidden_actions: call FiveK film, film stock, scanner, emulsion or calibrated evidence
infer content cells from image colour, embeddings, source or geometry
change losses, capacity, thresholds, samples or permutation after formal output
reuse the confirmation population to redesign a candidate
promote a product or commercial-use asset
claim_ceiling: research-only real-raster digital-retouch control of an unpaired marginal appearance candidate under externally observed photograph cells; no film, stock, physical operator, calibration, preference, commercial or product claim
